Abstract intermediate class for SE-backed datasets

Source: R/ExploreDatasetSE.R
ExploreDatasetSE.Rd

ExploreDatasetSE holds the SummarizedExperiment backend reference and implements the accessor contract uniformly for every SE shape. Concrete subclasses (ExploreDatasetSE_RNASeq, _CountQC, _CrisprCountQC, _Proteomics) override two private methods only:

  • .build_config(se) — returns the per-instance config list at $initialize() time

  • .prep() — populates private$.features_df, private$.de_dfs, private$.fid_lookup from the SE

This class is not instantiable on its own — instantiate a concrete subclass instead.

Value

An R6 class generator; the concrete subclasses' $new() returns an object inheriting from ExploreDatasetSE.

Canonical assay names from the config's assay map whose SE assay exists; computed assays are always included.

ExploreDatasetSE$assay()

One assay as a features x samples matrix with rows renamed to feature IDs; normalised_log2, vst, fpkm and tpm are computed when the config maps them to no SE assay.

Usage

ExploreDatasetSE$assay(name, features = NULL, samples = NULL)

Arguments

name

Canonical assay name, one of assay_names().

features

Feature IDs (rows) to keep; NULL keeps all.

samples

Sample IDs (columns) to keep; NULL keeps all.

ExploreDatasetSE$enrichment()

Enrichment results of one kind, read from metadata(se) and flattened to a named list; an empty list when absent. contrast is not used.

Usage

Arguments

contrast

Contrast name; not used by this backend.

kind

"ora" or "gsea".

ExploreDatasetSE$enrichment_input()

Examples

se <- readRDS(system.file("examples/proteomics/SummarizedExperiment.rds", package = "exploreDE"))
eds <- new_explore_dataset(se)
inherits(eds, "ExploreDatasetSE")
#> [1] TRUE
eds$assay_names()
#> [1] "intensities"
dim(eds$raw_assay())
#> [1] 1384    6
